defects.claim: The issue says to restyle `DashboardShippedChart` or replace where the dashboard uses it, and the PR does neither. The old "Shipped Activity" panel still renders at `<DashboardShippedChart :activity="filteredActivity" :projects="projects" />` and the new chart is added next to it at DashboardView.vue:342, so the desktop dashboard now shows two activity charts. The new panel also sits below the old chart, not directly under the stat row (DashboardView.vue:316) as the design describes

The issue says that if the endpoint has no range parameter, the PR body must say the chart buckets client-side. The PR body has only the copied issue text and the Evidence block. The statement appears only in code comments at DashboardActivityChart.vue:10 and DashboardView.vue:231
defects.evidence: evidence: the "## Changes" section of the PR body.

defects.claim: The mock activity feed never produces a `pr_merged` entry, so in mock or dev mode the new chart never shows a highlighted bar. A Grep for `pr_merged` under src/lib finds it only in httpAdapter.ts, types.ts, activityMessage.ts and test fixtures. This breaks the CLAUDE.md rule that adapter, mock and fixtures move in lockstep
defects.evidence: evidence: the Grep of `kind: 'pr_merged'` in mockAdapter.ts returns no matches.

defects.claim: The issue asks for the warm accent from `dashboardShippedColors.ts`, but that file holds only the neutral chart series (`CHART_COLORS = ['var(--color-chart-1)', …]`, dashboardShippedColors.ts:7). The PR uses `bg-needs-you` instead. The change is documented in the docblock but is still a departure from the spec.

`now` defaults to `new Date()` once, when the component mounts, and DashboardView.vue:342 does not pass a `now` prop. If the dashboard stays open, the bucket window never moves forward and new events at or after the mount time are dropped by `t >= end`.

No view test covers `loadBoardActivity` or the new chart (a Grep for `listBoardActivity|DashboardActivityChart` there finds nothing). So the fetch on mount and the fallback to an empty chart when the fetch fails (DashboardView.vue:234-240) are untested.

not_verified: Whether the server's `GET /api/v1/board/activity` caps or pages its results. A cap would undercount the 30D range. The backend producer (`internal/boardapi`) is not in this checkout.
7. Acceptance, `make build`/`test`/`lint` output pasted: met in the PR body. All 68 test files passed (951 tests), the build succeeded and `vue-tsc` ran clean. — not traced
notes:
1. Panel styling (Activity title left, 1D·7D·30D switch right, both 12px; 9.67px bars, 8px gap, 2px radius): met. See DashboardActivityChart.vue:62 (`text-ds-label`, which is `--text-ds-label: 12px` at theme.css:60) and :82 (`w-[9.67px] … rounded-[2px]`, with `gap-2` at :77). A size tweak would break this only if the token changed, and it is fixed at 12px. The placement and replacement part fails (see the blocking defect).
2. Bucket size per range (1D = 24 hourly, 7D = 7 daily, 30D = 30 daily): met at DashboardActivityChart.vue:26-28. The bucket index `Math.floor((t - start)/bucketMs)` (:43) could only go out of range at `t == end`, and the `t >= end` guard at :42 excludes that case.
3. Re-request or bucket client-side: the endpoint takes no parameters (`request<WireActivityEnvelope>('/api/v1/board/activity')`, httpAdapter.ts:1584). The PR fetches once at DashboardView.vue:236 and buckets in the browser, which is the allowed fallback. The PR body does not mention it (see the minor defect).
4. Wire fields: `createdAt` is mapped at httpAdapter.ts:729 (`createdAt: wire.createdAt`) and `kind: 'pr_merged'` at httpAdapter.ts:746-749, both from `WireActivityEnvelope.activity` (httpAdapter.ts:661-662). A row with an unknown kind is filtered out at :1585, so it cannot crash the bucketing.
5. Acceptance, test for three buttons and the bucket count changing: met at DashboardActivityChart.spec.ts:15-24 (7 → 24 → 30 bars).
6. Acceptance, test for highlighted and muted classes with mixed events: met at DashboardActivityChart.spec.ts:26-31, where both `bg-needs-you` and `bg-ink/30` are asserted. The test mounts the component with fixture props and does not mock the adapter. The adapter contract is covered separately by httpAdapter.spec.ts:1486.
8. Existing chart tests still pass: met. `DashboardShippedChart` is unchanged and still used by SettingsUsageView.vue:162.
9. Nearby code read: the existing `load()` at DashboardView.vue:173 does not affect the new fetch. The `v-else` at :308 hides the new chart while the dashboard is loading or has errored, which is consistent with the rest of the page. No database migrations are involved, and the issue has no out-of-scope section.
